verdict.rationale: Veriff offers a Public API collection in Postman (veriff-docs-44), which is a machine-readable, importable description of the API and roughly equivalent to a spec. However, probes of the standard OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404 (veriff-probe-2), and the API reference appears only as markdown pages. Missing for 10: a published, downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger file; evidence that the Postman collection is directly downloadable and complete; independent corroboration.
